products.name: AlphaSense
products.note: Market intelligence AI; financial research; insider information risk; MNPI controls needed

profile_text.body:
AlphaSense is a market intelligence and search platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in New York, NY. The company describes itself as an AI-powered tool that searches across more than 500 million documents to surface company insights, market data, and research, with the stated aim of helping users make faster decisions. Its site positions the platform as focused on high-quality, proprietary content and claims its outputs include sentence-level citations and no hallucinations.

The core product, also called AlphaSense, falls in the Finance and Legal AI category and is described as covering financial research and market intelligence. The platform includes features the company calls Smart Synonyms and Expert Insights, alongside a Deep Research capability that applies generative AI reasoning models to user content sets. Named customers on the site include Recurve Capital, where an individual named Aaron Chan is cited as a user, and Royalty Pharma, which the site describes as using the platform for biopharma due diligence and expert transcripts.

The site's held facts note that AlphaSense carries 260 legal exposures filed in New York, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data. The product record flags insider information risk and the need for MNPI controls as relevant considerations for users of the platform, reflecting the sensitivity of the financial research context in which it operates.
